mailbox_api.h

Initialize the Secure Device Manager mailbox, execute mailbox commands, and release mailbox resources.

Constants
MAILBOX_OK

Successful mailbox API status.

MAILBOX_ERROR

Mailbox API status returned when the shared client is unavailable or a synchronous send fails.

MAILBOX_NO_RESPONSE

Reserved mailbox status. The current synchronous mailbox_exec() path does not return this value.

MAILBOX_CMD_NOOP

Secure Device Manager mailbox no-operation command opcode.

MAILBOX_CMD_CONFIG_STATUS

Secure Device Manager mailbox configuration-status command opcode.

MAILBOX_CMD_GET_IDCODE

Secure Device Manager mailbox device-ID command opcode.

MAILBOX_CONFIG_STATUS_RESP_WORDS

Expected configuration-status response capacity in 32-bit words.

mailbox_init
int32_t mailbox_init(
void
)

Acquire the shared Secure Device Manager (SDM) mailbox client used by mailbox_exec().

Returns

MAILBOX_OK on success. MAILBOX_ERROR when the mailbox client cannot be acquired.

mailbox_deinit
void mailbox_deinit(
void
)

Release the shared mailbox client and clear the API handle.

mailbox_exec
int32_t mailbox_exec(
uint32_t 
cmd,
uint32_t 
*
args,
uint32_t 
arg_words,
uint32_t 
*
resp_ddr,
uint32_t 
resp_words
)

Send one SDM mailbox command through the synchronous mailbox client and return after mbox_send_command() completes.

Parameters
cmd
uint32_t

SDM mailbox command opcode.

args
uint32_t*

Argument words in DDR accepted by TF-A is_address_in_ddr_range() (addr >= BL31_LIMIT, typically 0x82000000 on Agilex 5/72), or NULL when arg_words is 0. Stack/BSS buffers in this image sit below BL31_LIMIT and are rejected.

arg_words
uint32_t

Number of 32-bit words in args.

resp_ddr
uint32_t*

Response buffer with the same TF-A address rule, or NULL when no response payload is required.

resp_words
uint32_t

Capacity of resp_ddr in 32-bit words.

Returns

MAILBOX_OK on success. MAILBOX_ERROR when mailbox_init() has not acquired a client or mbox_send_command() fails. MAILBOX_NO_RESPONSE is not returned by the current synchronous implementation.

Notes

See api/mailbox/README.md (Before You Start) for the full buffer-placement guidance.
